verdicts.reason: A: the legal fine print has been enlarged to subhead size and jammed directly under the headline with almost no gap, so it competes with the CTA. The sale banner (top-left) and logo (top-right) are scattered with no shared axis, and the product floats in a large dead zone. B: it has a deliberate two-column split, but the legal line is still promoted to a large subhead, the headline ends on the orphan 'longer', the shrunken sale banner is crammed into the top-right corner over the grey planet, and the product sits low and out of balance with the text column.
